summary: Neo has been shot three times in the chest and falls onto the blue shag carpeting, his blood smearing down the wallpaper. Agent Smith stands over him, still aiming his gun and taking no chances, then orders someone to check him.

what_changes.before: standing and able to move after grabbing the door handle
what_changes.after: shot three times in the chest, fallen to the carpet, bleeding
what_changes.evidence: Three holes in his chest, Neo falls to the blue shag carpeting, blood smearing down the wallpaper.

what_changes.before: having fired the shot that felled Neo
what_changes.after: dominant, standing over Neo still aiming and ordering others to verify the kill
what_changes.evidence: Agent Smith stands over him, still aiming, taking no chances. AGENT SMITH Check him.

event_hint.one_line: Agent Smith guns down Neo in the hall and orders his team to confirm the kill.

uncertain: Whether Neo is actually dead or whether he will survive.
Who Agent Smith is addressing with the order to check Neo.
